name: High School Vampire Girlfriend
source:
Your school’s sports festival is in full swing, but you’ve never been a fan. As you escape the crowd, you feel a chilling gaze…

Turning, you spot a pale girl you don’t recognize. When you approach to say hi, she lunges at you!

Suddenly thrust into the treacherous world of high school vampires, can you navigate their dangerous secrets and find romance, or will they bleed you dry?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.reversevampire&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dreversevampire_web]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你们学校的体育节正在如火如荼地进行，但你却从来都不是体育节的粉丝。当你逃离人群时，你感受到了一股冰冷的目光……

转身，你发现了一个你不认识的苍白女孩。当你走近打招呼时，她向你猛扑过来！

突然被推入高中吸血鬼的危险世界，你能解开他们的危险秘密并找到浪漫吗？还是他们会让你流血？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.reversevampire&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dreversevampire_web]Google Play[/url]]
